newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks leap in early morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks leap in early morning trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks leaped in early morning trade on Tuesday following a long weekend, propelled by a stronger overseas market overnight, brokers said.
They said the Nikkei average was aiming to test its recent closing high of 21,363, achieved on August 22.

In early trade, the cash stock market's benchmark Nikkei 225 average was up 347.27 points or 1.67 percent at 21,189.91. In the futures market, the key December futures contract was up 370 points at 21,240.
"It looks like foreign investors have become net buyers again so that should provide the market with some support as well as confidence," a broker at one of Japan's "Big Four" brokerages said.
